soundness_flags.label: def:ipw-z-estimator; Theorems 1--2
soundness_flags.one_line: The approximate-minimum rule only yields \(\|G_T(\widehat\theta_T)\|=O_P(T^{-1/2})\), so the displayed Z-expansion is missing the load-bearing residual \(\sqrt T H^{-1}G_T(\widehat\theta_T)\); it need not be \(O_P(e_T)\) or vanish.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorems 1--4 / def:finite-attractor-class
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Finite tail selection, positive basin masses, and the common Cesaro attraction modulus are assumed class restrictions, not derived for the Guo--Xu recursion.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The stable-mixture, realized-QV, and deterministic-sandwich conclusions are field-tier conditional results UNDER membership in the stated common-envelope finite-attractor class.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Open-ended Question 1

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes nonconvergence to unstable critical points under an omnidirectional-noise condition; it does not classify the proposed bounded recursion's complete limit set.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the approximate-minimum estimator rule with an exact measurable estimating-equation root on a stated existence event, or impose \(\sqrt T\,\|G_T(\widehat\theta_T)\|=O_P(e_T)\) and carry that residual explicitly through Theorems 1--2.

Add a uniform two-basin coverage-gap corollary comparing any deterministic sandwich with the realized-QV pivot, including a nonzero lower bound at a named nominal level whenever projected basin variances differ.

Turn the bounded Guo--Xu dynamics question into an evidenced bridge by proving finite selection or by deriving a separatrix-margin restriction that yields concrete \(r_T\) and \(\delta_T\) rates on a nonempty initialization region.

recommended_next_step: Repair the Z-estimator residual specification first; then retain the conditional finite-attractor inference package as a field-tier Stage-0 target.
